method: Dice - common face and cyclic order
steps: Die 1 shows V (top), C, R; die 2 shows E (top), X, R
R is common; V, C, E, X are adjacent to R, so Z is opposite R
Cyclic order around the corner containing R: (R,V,C) and (R,E,X) same sense, so the ring around R is V, C, E, X
Opposite pairs: V-E, C-X; so X is opposite C
check_code:
import itertools
faces='VCREXZ'
# ring around R (4 faces adjacent to R) must contain V,C,E,X; view corner order (R,V,C) and (R,E,X) same orientation
ring_opts=[p for p in itertools.permutations('VCEX') if p[0]=='V']
def succ(ring,a,b):
    i=ring.index(a);return ring[(i+1)%4]==b
valid=[r for r in ring_opts if succ(r,'V','C') and succ(r,'E','X')]
opp={r[(r.index('C')+2)%4] for r in valid}
assert len(opp)==1
ans=opp.pop()
opts={'A':'R','B':'Z','C':'V','D':'X'}
assert ans==opts['D']
for k in 'ABC': assert ans!=opts[k]
